note: The entitlement server's RSA-2048 PUBLIC key. A public key is not a secret:
it can only CHECK a token, never make one, so it is committed on purpose and
a build is reproducible from this repository alone.
While it still says PLACEHOLDER, no token validates, so every player is a free
player and nothing unlocks. A build with no key must fail closed.
tools/make-entitlement-key.sh generates the real pair. The PRIVATE half goes to
the Cloudflare Worker via `wrangler secret put ENTITLEMENT_SIGNING_KEY` and must
JSON rather than .pem because Godot exports .json as a resource; a bare .pem
would need an include_filter entry in every preset and would be missing from a
build the first time somebody added a preset and forgot.
